the proposed multi-resonant current control scheme can effectively eliminate current harmonics in PWM rectifiers.
The proposed method can be applied to any PWM converter, not just the single phase one.

the design of a single-phase rectifier with a novel multi-resonant controller.
the control of the single-phase PWM rectification process in the presence of a non-linear load.
the development of a novel multi-resonant current control scheme for single-phase PWM rectifying converters.

the proposed MRSC is a promising control method for selective current harmonics elimination in PWM rectifiers.
this paper proposes a multi resonant control (MRC) scheme for PWM converters to eliminate selective harmonic distortion in current.
the proposed method has been shown to be a viable solution to the problem of current harmonic elimination for single-phase PWM rectification.

the proposed MRSC method can be used to eliminate selective current harmonic distortion in PWM rectifier.
the proposed method is capable of reducing current harmonics and is suitable for the control of single-phase rectifiers.

the MRSC scheme is capable of achieving selective harmonic elimination with the same switching frequency as the fundamental component.
